method: Exact Fraction biquadratic geometry and Hermite field rows; physical Cartesian gradient difference after clearing exact Jacobian determinants; p+6 rational unisolvence nodes per span; exact sparse Gaussian elimination over Q with prime-field crosschecks.
scope: Section-only scalar field, with all value/tangent vertices included. Projection ranks use rank([A;P])-rank(A) over Q and include endpoints and vertices. Transverse observables are first-side physical-gradient numerators with the known nonzero geometry determinant omitted. Axial factor, boundary clamp, 3D solve, and convergence are outside this audit.
